title: Label hit
description: One OCR'd label matched inside a map, warped to the ground where the map's georeference allows it. Returned by GET /api/search?include=labels. One hit per place, not per sheet: the same name on several maps is collapsed into the best match, which carries the count of the rest in other_sheets.

year.description: The source map's year; the only date a single sheet supports.

text.description: The reviewer's correction where one exists, else the model's reading.

category.description: Legend and title furniture is never returned: a legend entry names a class, not a place.

bbox.description: Source-image pixel bbox [x, y, w, h]. Always present, because pixels are the master.

lng.description: Null when the map has no usable georeference.

other_sheets.description: Further sheets carrying this same name, collapsed into this hit. The sheets themselves are listed on the place page.
